anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: They follow the Lamb wherever he goes.
The prize of the upward calling.

pass_a_gloss: And as many as partake of the thighs keep the flesh undefiled, following wherever Christ goes; and those of the feet, no longer being sluggish, run in zeal into the prize of the upper calling of Christ; and head would be the faith, and feet the works, without which the faith is dead.
pass_b_english: And those who partake of the thighs keep the flesh undefiled, following wherever Christ goes. Those of the feet, no longer being sluggish, run with zeal toward the prize of the upward calling of Christ. And the head would be the faith, and the feet the works, without which faith is dead (Revelation 14:4) (Romans 12:11) (Philippians 3:14) (James 2:17) (James 2:26).
source_text: ὅσοι δὲ μεταλαμβάνουσι τῶν μηρῶν ἀμόλυντον τὴν σάρκα φυλάττουσιν ἀκολουθοῦντες ὅπου ἂν ὑπάγῃ Χ(ριστό)ς· οἱ δὲ τῶν ποδῶν, μηκέτι ὄντες ὀκνηροὶ τῇ σπουδῇ τρέχουσιν εἰς τὸ βραβεῖον τῆς ἄνω κλήσεως τοῦ Χ(ριστο)ῦ· εἴεν δ’ ἂν καὶ κεφαλὴ μὲν ἡ πίστις, πόδες δὲ τὰ ἔργα, ὧν χωρὶς ἡ πίστις νεκρά ἐστι. ||
